question: Who Owns Tropical Smoothie Cafe?
quick_answer: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is owned by Blackstone, the large investment firm, which acquired the chain in 2024. The brand began back in 1993 as a smoothie shop in Destin, Florida, started franchising later in the 1990s, and grew into a national cafe chain before being bought by Blackstone.
key_facts: Began in 1993 as a smoothie shop in Destin, Florida
Franchising program started in the late 1990s
Grew into a national smoothie and food cafe chain

body.heading: Who owns Tropical Smoothie Cafe?
body.text: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is owned by Blackstone, one of the world's largest investment firms, which acquired the chain in 2024. Before Blackstone, the brand had been owned by other private investment firms as it expanded. It is privately held rather than publicly traded.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Tropical Smoothie Cafe traces back to 1993, when it began as a smoothie shop in Destin, Florida. The company set up its franchising arm later in the 1990s and opened early franchised cafes, then grew steadily into a national chain known for smoothies alongside wraps, sandwiches and flatbreads.

body.heading: What Blackstone ownership means
body.text: Blackstone's ownership is aimed at funding further growth for Tropical Smoothie Cafe. Most locations are run by franchisees, so day-to-day the cafes are operated locally while Blackstone backs the brand as owner.

faqs.q: Is Tropical Smoothie Cafe publicly traded?
faqs.a: No. Tropical Smoothie Cafe is privately held, owned by Blackstone, which acquired it in 2024.

faqs.q: When was Tropical Smoothie Cafe founded?
faqs.a: The brand began in 1993 as a smoothie shop in Destin, Florida, and set up its franchising arm later in the 1990s.

faqs.q: Who owns Tropical Smoothie Cafe now?
faqs.a: Blackstone, the global investment firm, which acquired the chain in 2024.
